premises.text: Developing a winning portfolio requires analyzing daily stock prices, corporate fundamentals, and financial news.
premises.evidence_span: To develop a winning portfolio, a perfect trader would need to, with all of the news, examine the daily stock prices of each company, analyze corporate stock fundamentals and synthesize this into a cohesive trading strategy every single day.

premises.text: Traders are considering using AI for their daily trading activity.
premises.evidence_span: In a recent poll of over 10,000 traders, we found that three out of four are considering using artificial intelligence or AI for their daily trading activity.

premises.text: AI technology can generate a cohesive trading strategy based on stock prices and fundamentals.
premises.evidence_span: we've built a technology that analyzes daily stock prices, corporate fundamentals and financial news to generate a tested, cohesive trading strategy.

premises.text: The platform offers ready-to-use trading strategies that are back tested.
premises.evidence_span: The platform offers several ready to use trading strategies, which are three years back tested and powered by AI that can be deployed on a third party broker with few clicks.

premises.text: Live testing allows users to validate performance before investing real money.
premises.evidence_span: Forward testing or live testing comes as a second layer where individuals can validate live performance by running automated paper trading.

premises.text: Naotic's algorithms analyze financial market data to classify stocks.
premises.evidence_span: The proprietary Naotic algorithms analyze daily all U.S. stocks financial markets data, extract features and labels, group stocks into clusters and classify them as winners or losers accordingly.

premises.text: Naotic does not require traders to know how to write code for backtesting.
premises.evidence_span: Competitors like Quantopian offer data to coders to do backtesting, but they require traders to know how to write codes, while Naotic doesn't.

premises.text: The financial markets data analysis is a significant market.
premises.evidence_span: financial markets data analysis is a $30 billion market.

premises.text: Naotic acquires customers through various marketing strategies.
premises.evidence_span: We acquire our customers through specialized forums, email campaigns, Google AdWords, publishing articles, and referral by our connected brokers.

premises.text: Users are entitled to a free trial of the platform.
premises.evidence_span: Every user is entitled with a free trial.

value.text: Users can make informed trading decisions using AI-driven strategies.
value.evidence_span: start making some good returns on your money instead of keeping it under your pay.
